card.title: Steam Deck - Flash MCU on controller board R rev. B

source.title: Steam Deck - Flash MCU on controller board R rev. B

models: Steam Deck LCD (controller board R rev. B)

claims.statement: A replacement RA4E1 MCU (R7FA4E10B2CFM 256 KB or R7FA4E10D2CFM 512 KB) on the rev. B controller board can be programmed over USB from SteamOS.

Run rfp_cli_linux.sh boot_ra_Release.srec in the RA_bootloader_updater folder and hold R1 + R4 + right '...' when prompted (or ground the MD pin); success shows 'Valve Software Steam Controller Bootloader' in lsusb, then SteamOS flashes the app on next boot.
A brand-new MCU may not report serial numbers, so overlay updates fail (desktop mode updates work).

procedure: Run the flash script; hold the magic button combo.
Check lsusb for the bootloader, reboot, confirm controller works.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
